title: Code — overlay syntax editor
description: A lightweight code editor: line-number gutter, transparent-textarea-over-highlighted-pre overlay (regex tokenizer for JS/TS/JSON/CSS), tab strip with dirty dots, Cmd/Ctrl+S save, a lazy per-directory explorer tree with inline new-file/new-folder, a responsive new-file form (dialog ⇄ bottom drawer), and a status bar (path, Ln/Col, language, save state). The filesystem is INJECTED via a small CodeFsAdapter (list/read/write/mkdir) — point it at a real API or use the bundled writable in-memory mock (seeded sample tree) so it works with zero backend. Self-contained: shell inspector hooks are inert seams in lib/host.ts.
